Pregame video & voiceover script

Not built yet for Cairns. No Synergy clips or bespoke tactical cues have been sourced for this roster (see "How this hub is built" below), and this section's usual format leans on both - building it now would mean inventing cues, which this project deliberately doesn't do. Once real film exists, this panel follows the same 3-minute structure as the Tasmania version: cold open, starters at 8 sec each keyed to their #1 scout note, a 3-question recall check mirroring the card quizzes, bench unit at a faster cut, and a close on the Keys to Victory box.

Locker-room print sheet

Use your browser's Print (Cmd/Ctrl+P) on this page for a stripped-down, high-contrast one-pager of all 15 "3 keys" lists - no photos, no quiz, sized for a locker-room wall or a laminated card in a warm-up bag. Everything else on this page hides automatically in print.

How this hub is built & what still needs a human

Why cards, a quiz and a HUD

Same learning-science approach as the Tasmania hub this was built from: chunking (a short, fixed set of facts per player rather than everything at once); retrieval practice (the flip-quiz forces players to produce the answer, not just re-read it); and dual coding, once real film exists to pair with the cards.

What's real vs. placeholder here

  • Roster, jersey numbers and positions are cross-checked against nbl.com.au (fetched 4 Sep 2026) and the club's own "Opponent Shooting #s" depth chart, which carries more precise positions (e.g. PG/SG/SF rather than just G/F) — used to infer the Starters/Rotation/Bench grouping below, based on depth-chart order and IP/DP tags. That grouping is inferred, not officially confirmed by Markus — worth a check.
  • Shooter designations (Sniper/Shooter/Driver) are lifted verbatim from the club's own "Opponent Shooting #s" sheet, which already had them filled in for 11 of 15 players when this build started. Jaylin Galloway, Luca Yates and Luke Paul have no designation in that sheet — shown as "no designation sourced" rather than guessed. Malique Lewis has 3PT data in that sheet but no designation was filled in for him either.
  • Box-score averages (MIN/PPG/3P%/FT%/FT RATE) use the same two-season, all-competitions, GP-weighted-blend method as Tasmania's build (RealGM, checked 4 Sep 2026) — OREB% stays N/A for every player here, same rule as Tasmania: none of the sourced lines carry a real OREB% figure, only raw per-game rebound counts, and a raw count is never substituted for a percentage.
  • Jack McVeigh is a known partial. RealGM's row for his real 2024-25/2025-26 minutes returned materially different numbers on repeated fetches — a genuine, reproducible extraction failure, not a "no data" case. Rather than use that unreliable row, or his real-but-misleading 9-game NBA garbage-time stint, his MIN/PPG/FT%/FT RATE are left TBD; only his 3P% (35.2%) is shown, sourced instead from the club's own Synergy-tracked shooting sheet. Flagged on his card — worth a direct manual RealGM check before game day.
  • Luke Paul has no senior-level stats anywhere. RealGM's only table for him is junior national-team tournaments (U16/U17), consistent with a young, not-yet-signed prospect rather than a wrong player. His avg2 is fully N/A, flagged on his card as a real gap, not an error.
  • Individual tactical cues ("keys") are deliberately NOT written in Tasmania's style here. Tasmania's per-player cues turned out to be bespoke coaching judgment — not something derivable from a player's shooter category alone — and no equivalent individual notes exist yet for Cairns anywhere in the club's files. Rather than invent plausible-sounding tactical prose and present it as real scouting judgment, each card shows only its shooter designation (a real, sourced fact) plus a closeout cue drawn from the same designation-based convention already used elsewhere in this hub, and an honest note that individual tactical notes aren't sourced yet. The team-level scheme table from the club's "SCOUT PREP CAIRNS" doc (PNR coverage, press, OOB actions) is real and now shown on the Team Overview tab, wired in on 4 Sep 2026 once that doc had a full table to show — cells the doc itself left blank (mostly the "How we'll attack/counter it" side) show "Pending source" rather than an invented counter.
  • Photos are the 15 real player photos Markus sent (4 Sep 2026), matched to roster names in the order he confirmed. The Cairns Taipans logo (also supplied by Markus, 4 Sep 2026) had its navy background removed and was cropped to the artwork so it sits in the hero the same way the Bullets logo does.
  • Matchups are populated for 12 of 15 players. The club's "SCOUT PREP CAIRNS" doc was updated with a full list by first name only; Markus supplied the first-name-to-surname mapping directly (4 Sep 2026), so those are shown here as Bullets surnames, per his instruction to use surnames only. Nunn has no matchup entry at all in the doc, so nothing is shown for him rather than guessed. Two things flagged rather than silently resolved: the doc lists Kyrin Galloway twice — once with real defenders, once marked "injured" — his real matchup is shown, but worth confirming which is current; and Luke Paul is listed "injured" with no defenders at all, shown as an injury flag on his card instead of a matchup.
  • The game date shown ("Date TBC") couldn't be confirmed from the Bullets' pre-season schedule document in Drive — it's a stale draft with an ambiguous calendar grid that only lists Cairns as a possible participant in a shared training camp, not a confirmed head-to-head fixture date.

Reusing this for the next opponent

Everything on this page is driven by one data array at the top of the file - swap in a new opponent's roster (name, number, stats, keys, quiz) and republish; the cards, HUD, print sheet and video script section all rebuild themselves from it.

SOURCES: nbl.com.au roster (fetched 4 Sep 2026) · club "Opponent Shooting #s" sheet (shooter designations, checked 4 Sep 2026) · club "SCOUT PREP CAIRNS" doc (team scheme, partial matchups) · RealGM (box-score averages, checked 4 Sep 2026) · this is a working prototype, not a final scouting authority - verify every flagged item (game date, matchups, McVeigh's box score, the inferred rotation grouping) before game day.
